title: cost-report template variables
description: Values for templates/cost-report.md.j2 and templates/cost-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from cost-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

billing_month.title: Billing month
billing_month.description: The month this covers, as month and year. Cloud bills land late and get restated - naming the month rather than "last month" is what makes two of these comparable.

budget_amount.title: Budget amount
budget_amount.description: The budget this is measured against, with currency. If nobody set one, say so plainly here rather than omitting the line - "no budget" is the finding.

db_id.title: Db id
db_id.description: The db id used under 'Waste Identified'.

instance_id.title: Instance id
instance_id.description: The instance id used under 'Waste Identified'.

largest_driver.title: Largest driver
largest_driver.description: The single service or team that moved the bill most this month, up or down. One name. A report whose headline is "compute" tells the reader nothing they could act on.

report_owner.title: Report owner
report_owner.description: Who compiles this and chases the actions. Finance can read the number; only somebody with a name will turn off the instance.

team_b.title: Team b
team_b.description: The team b used under 'Cost by Team'.

team_c.title: Team c
team_c.description: The team c used under 'Cost by Team'.

total_spend.title: Total spend
total_spend.description: Total spend for the month, with currency. Take it from the billing export, not the console dashboard - the dashboard usually excludes tax, support and marketplace charges.

waste_owner_deadline.title: Waste owner deadline
waste_owner_deadline.description: The date idle resources listed below must be assigned to a team lead, ISO. Waste sections without a date get re-published unchanged for months; that is the normal failure of this report.
